audience: recruiters and hiring managers who manage candidates in Recruitee

useCases.title: Find candidates for a job or by keyword
useCases.text: The AI searches candidates by keywords in name, tags, CV and more, or lists them for one job, newest first, qualified or disqualified. It opens a profile with tags, CV link and job stages.

useCases.title: See interviews coming up
useCases.text: The AI lists scheduled interviews with candidate, job, start time, location and attendees, for the company or one interviewer.

useCases.title: Read notes and evaluations of a candidate
useCases.text: The AI reads the notes on a candidate and the interview evaluations with rating and note, and sums up what the team thinks.

useCases.title: Add a candidate and put them on a job
useCases.text: The AI adds a candidate with contact details and puts them on a job or talent pool.

useCases.title: Add a note or tags, or create a task
useCases.text: The AI adds a note or tags to a candidate, or creates a recruiting task for team members, optionally about a candidate and with a due date.

useCases.title: Move a candidate to another pipeline stage
useCases.text: The AI reads the candidate's job placements and the stages of the job's hiring pipeline, then moves the candidate to the stage you choose.
